contract_gap.consequence: CONTRACT_A_V035.md alone does not determine a unique Contract B from calibration data.
contract_gap.description: Section 6.1 and section 12 enumerate numeric outputs but omit candidate grids, deterministic selection maps, calibration search budgets, and failure stopping rules for several outputs.
contract_gap.handling: This auxiliary protocol is frozen before reading any seed 100-105 calibration output. It does not amend Contract A. The deviation must remain visible in MANIFEST_B_V035.json and in the final report.

failure_rules.general: Any non-finite required metric, incomplete candidate set, raw/checkpoint mismatch, digest mismatch, or seed outside 100-105 stops calibration without Contract B.
failure_rules.gating: If no g_tol candidate has the minimum relevant one-sided 95% LCB at least p_min_floor, stop. Do not lower p_min below p_min_floor.
failure_rules.hessian: If no epsilon has stable physical eigenvalues or rigid-mode rank is not six, stop.
failure_rules.md: If no (dt,n_md) candidate satisfies max relative NVE drift below 1e-3 on every calibration state and e_kin candidate, stop.
failure_rules.pt: If no PT candidate executes the exact budget on all six seeds, stop. A best available ladder may be selected even if its diagnostic target band is missed, but target miss is recorded.
failure_rules.sham: If an operation-check metric is undefined in any calibration pair, stop rather than silently widening its band.

selection_rules.T_BH: Run A0 for every candidate and seed at the calibration budget. Minimize median best energy; ties within 1e-9 choose larger median nquench, then smaller T_BH.
selection_rules.diag_grad_budget: Let U be all diagnostic gradient calls used by p_mu and Hessian calibration. Freeze ceil(U*1.25/10000)*10000.
selection_rules.g_tol: For each ascending candidate compute mu_bh and all three mu_pt one-sided 95% LCBs. Choose the smallest candidate whose minimum LCB is at least p_min_floor.
selection_rules.g_tol_hill: Choose the same value as g_tol unless the next smaller candidate has empirical pass rate at least 0.95 in both mu_bh and every mu_pt layer; in that case choose the smallest such candidate.
selection_rules.h_sigma: Run A3 for every Cartesian-product candidate at selected T_BH. Feasible means median accept_flip_rate in [0.05,0.25], median nhills at least 10, and all required diagnostics finite. Among feasible candidates minimize abs(log(median_accept_flip_rate/0.10))+abs(log((median_nearest_center_mean/sigma)/1.0)); ties within 1e-12 choose smaller h, then smaller sigma. If none is feasible, stop.
selection_rules.hessian: For each reference structure and epsilon compute the projected Hessian. For each epsilon except the finest, compare the 3n-6 physical eigenvalues with the next finer epsilon after removing six smallest-absolute modes. Choose the largest epsilon with maximum absolute difference <=1e-4 and maximum relative difference <=1e-4. zero_eigenvalue_threshold=max(1e-8,10*maximum absolute removed eigenvalue at the selected epsilon). negative_eigenvalue_threshold=max(1e-6,10*maximum physical-spectrum absolute difference to the next finer epsilon).
selection_rules.k_max: At the final calibration probe, compute per-seed wall-time ratios for A2/A1, A3/A0, A5/A0, and B1/B2. Freeze ceil(max median ratio*1.25/0.25)*0.25.
selection_rules.md_integrator: On six fixed calibration minima, test every dt,n_md,e_kin. A dt,n_md pair is feasible only if maximum NVE relative drift over all states and all e_kin candidates is <1e-3. Select feasible pair maximizing dt*n_md; ties choose smaller dt, then larger n_md.
selection_rules.p_min: At selected g_tol, let L be the minimum of the mu_bh LCB and all three mu_pt layer LCBs. Freeze min(p_min_target,floor(L/0.05)*0.05). Stop if this is below p_min_floor.
selection_rules.proposal_scale: At selected dt,n_md compute RMS descriptor displacement for every md_e_kin and random_step over the same fixed states and random streams. Choose the pair minimizing abs(log(rms_md/rms_random)); ties choose the larger geometric-mean displacement, then smaller e_kin, then smaller step. Freeze their geometric mean as rms_desc_disp target.
selection_rules.pt_A1_A6: With selected h,sigma,g tolerances, run A1 at fixed Tlo=0.05,Thi=0.20 for M in the grid. For each candidate compute the minimum adjacent-pair acceptance and pooled first-two-anneal-interval acceptance. Prefer candidates with min pair acceptance in [0.10,0.45]; among them minimize absolute deviation of pooled pre-tail acceptance from 0.20, then choose smaller M. If none is in band, maximize min pair acceptance, then minimize deviation from 0.20, then smaller M. A6 uses this exact ladder.
selection_rules.pt_A7: Run PT-only on each listed ladder with M inherited from A1. Choose the candidate minimizing absolute difference between pooled first-two-anneal-interval acceptance and the selected A1 value; ties choose larger log(Thi/Tlo), then larger Thi.
selection_rules.q_r: Using all converged calibration descriptors, form pairs whose energy differs by more than 0.1 epsilon. Let d_min be their minimum descriptor distance. Choose the smallest r for which 4*sqrt(703)*0.5*10^-r < d_min. If no candidate satisfies it, stop.
selection_rules.sham_bands: For penalty_energy_mean, penalty_fire_rate, accept_flip_rate, nearest_center_mean, and donor_overlap_rate, compute the six A4 calibration values at final parameters. Freeze [max(0,q05-0.20*max(abs(q05),1e-12)), q95+0.20*max(abs(q95),1e-12)]. A screening A4 run passes only if every metric lies in its band. f_sham_max is fixed above, not estimated from these six pairs.
selection_rules.t_max_screen: Take the maximum median recipient-only wall time among final-probe A4, B2, A6, A7. Scale linearly from calibration budget to 150000, multiply by 1.25, and round upward to the next 10 seconds.
selection_rules.tau: Apply the frozen Geyer IPS function separately to each raw gate-indicator trajectory. Freeze tau_bh and tau_pt as the maximum ceil(2*tau_int) across, respectively, all BH trajectories and all PT trajectories/layers. Retain the first n_per_traj observations after deterministic thinning; no burn-in.
selection_rules.tie_threshold: Repeat every reference energy evaluation 32 times. Freeze delta_tie=max(1e-6,100*maximum absolute repeat discrepancy). The additional deterministic selection tie epsilon is 1e-12.
